question: Who won the men’s race at the 2025 Paris Marathon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bénard Biwott**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Bénard Biwott**, a prominent long-distance runner from **Kenya**, emerged as the winner of the men’s elite race at the **2025 Paris Marathon**. 
• The event took place on **April 13, 2025**, where Biwott managed to outpace a highly competitive field of international athletes to claim the title. 
• He crossed the finish line with a remarkable time of **2:05:44**, securing his victory after pulling away from the lead group in the final stages of the **42.195-kilometer** course. 
• The podium was rounded out by fellow **Kenyan** athlete **Sila Kiptoo**, who took the **second position**, and **Ibrahim Hassan** from **Djibouti**, who finished in **third place**. ***Hence, option 1 is correct.*** 
• This victory marks a significant milestone in **Bénard Biwott’s** career, solidifying his reputation in the world of major city marathons. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Paris Marathon (Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris)**: 
• The **Paris Marathon** is one of the world's most popular distance running events, held annually through the streets of **Paris, France**. 
• The course begins on the **Champs-Élysées** and passes by several iconic landmarks, including the **Place de la Concorde**, the **Louvre**, and the **Eiffel Tower**, before finishing near **Porte Dauphine**. 
• It is classified as a **World Athletics Elite Label Road Race**, attracting tens of thousands of participants from over **140 countries** each year. 
• **Kenyan Dominance in Athletics**: 
• **Kenya** has a long-standing history of producing world-class marathon runners. Athletes like **Eliud Kipchoge** and the late **Kelvin Kiptum** have set global benchmarks in this discipline. 
• The victory of **Bénard Biwott** in **2025** continues the trend of **East African** dominance in the **Paris** event, where **Kenyan** and **Ethiopian** runners frequently occupy the top spots. 
• **Race Logistics and Participation**: 
• The **2025** edition saw over **50,000 runners** registered for the event, highlighting its status as a major fixture in the global sporting calendar. 
• The marathon serves not only as a platform for elite professional athletes but also as a massive mass-participation event for amateur runners aiming to complete the **26.2-mile** distance.
